enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Upgradeable Item (Temple of Elemental Evil): This item can be upgraded. Bring this item to the Overgrown Workbench in the Temple of Elemental Evil and combine it with Rusty Gilled Mushrooms to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Dusk: Equipping this item engulfs you in twilight shadows. Attacks from enemies have a 10% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Fortification +75%: +75% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

enchantments.tooltip: Acid Absorption +10%: Passive: 10% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Resistance +2: Passive: +2 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
